result_text:
I fixed the typos in the default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. I didn't write new tests for the fixed patterns. The scoping and convention tests I ran pass, but I haven't checked a `.htm`, `app.js`, `MyAssembly.xml` or `build-gradle.js` file against the new patterns.

- **Generated HTML (pkgdown, Doxygen, meta generator):** the file pattern was `(html|html|xhtml)`. It is now `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages are covered and `.html` and `.xhtml` still match.
- **`// Generated by …` JavaScript and `<doc>` XML:** the file patterns were `.*/[.]js` and `.*/[.]xml`, which only matched a file named exactly `.js` or `.xml`. They are now `.*[.]js` and `.*[.]xml`. Hand-written `.js` and `.xml` files still stay out of the generated scope, because the content line (`// Generated by` or `<doc>`) still has to match.
- **Gradle JavaScript scripts:** the pattern was `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js`, which only matched a file named `.-gradle.js`. It is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches. `.*[.]gradle` is unchanged, so `build.gradle` still matches.
